title: Alpha One — event account.day_rolled v1
description: V1 catalog event `account.day_rolled` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = EVL (daily reset), ANA. Derived from: docs/09 §3.6 (day_rolled trigger: 'trading_days++ (if any trade that day), calendar_days++; push daily_pnls'; broker-server midnight per ADR-12); skips SUSPENDED (D31). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

broker_date.description: the new broker-server date (YYYY-MM-DD, per server group timezone — ADR-12)
